prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic vertical UGC fashion-sharing portrait of an approved adult woman seated indoors at night, as if about to speak to the camera.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with a calm relaxed expression and subtle smile, wearing a cozy casual outfit selected from the supplied reference, touching the garment while presenting its key fashion feature.
prompt.composition_elements: Fixed face-height camera directly in front of the seated subject, stable forward-facing composition, clear face, personal indoor room, natural vlog posture, warm bright atmosphere, vertical 9:16.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Realistic warm indoor night lighting with gentle ambient falloff, no beauty filter, no artificial sharpening, natural background softness from the camera optics, comfortable vlog energy.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone video-frame aesthetic, vertical 9:16, face-height perspective, natural digital texture and mild phone-camera grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 UGC fashion-sharing portrait of an approved adult woman seated indoors at night, facing a fixed smartphone camera at face height. She has a calm relaxed expression and subtle smile, touches the supplied outfit while presenting its key fashion feature, and looks ready to begin a vlog. Personal warm room, realistic indoor lighting, natural phone-camera softness, no beauty filter, no artificial sharpening, authentic comfortable fashion-talk moment.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, exposed intimate areas, minors, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, studio backdrop, artificial bokeh, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, distorted hands, extra fingers, watermark, invented text

assets.name: cozy-night-fashion-share.jpg
assets.usage: Preserve the approved adult's face, outfit, seated pose, room, camera height, warm night light, and fashion-sharing mood.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve identity consistency, outfit, pose, room, framing, and lighting. Clothing and decor may be replaced while retaining the same fashion-talk composition. Do not invent typography or logos.
